title: Apple Watch deals UK: which model to buy and the price to pay
seoTitle: Apple Watch Deals UK: Best Prices on Series, SE & Ultra
description: Today's best UK Apple Watch prices for the Series 12, Series 11, SE 3 and Ultra, which one to buy, and the Black Friday price worth waiting for.
intro:
**The best Apple Watch deal in the UK right now is the Ultra 3 at £519 at Amazon, the lowest price recorded for it.** For most people, though, the Series 11 at £319 at Amazon is the smarter buy: it's last year's model, £50 less than the new Series 12, and almost the same watch.

The Series 12 and SE 3 are still at Apple's full price, so if you want either, wait for Amazon's Black Friday Week (19 to 30 November). Prices are from 16 and 17 November 2026.

body:
## Which Apple Watch should you buy?

There are four watches to choose from this Christmas. Apple launched the Series 12 and Ultra 4 in September 2026, so the Series 11 and Ultra 3 are now last year's models. Retailers are clearing them at lower prices, which is where the best value is.

- **Apple Watch SE 3 (from £219):** the cheapest. It does the essentials well: notifications, workouts, heart rate, sleep tracking, fall and crash detection. A good first watch, or one for a child or older relative using Family Setup (you'll need a cellular model for that).
- **Apple Watch Series 11 (from £319 at Amazon):** a bigger, brighter screen and extra health sensors, such as the ECG app, that the SE lacks. The best value for most adults.
- **Apple Watch Series 12 (from £369):** the newest standard model. A modest yearly upgrade over the Series 11, so it's only worth the extra £50 if you want the latest.
- **Apple Watch Ultra 3 (£519 at Amazon) and Ultra 4 (£749 RRP):** bigger, tougher titanium watches with much longer battery life, a brighter screen and an extra button. Ideal for runners, hikers, swimmers and anyone who hates charging daily.

## Apple Watch prices to aim for

These are today's prices at Amazon and the recent lows, so you know when a deal is real.

- **SE 3 40mm (RRP £219):** £219 today. Aim for £199 or less.
- **SE 3 44mm (RRP £249):** £249 today. It has been about £189; under £210 is good.
- **Series 11 42mm:** £319 today. It was £259 in October; under £280 is good.
- **Series 12 42mm (RRP £369) and 46mm (RRP £419):** full price, with no UK discounts yet.
- **Ultra 3:** £519, its lowest price so far. Buy now if you want one.
- **Ultra 4 (RRP £749):** around £719 to £729 at Amazon, a small saving.

## GPS or cellular?

GPS models need your iPhone nearby for calls and data. Cellular models can make calls, stream music and send messages on their own, but you'll need a separate mobile plan for the watch, which costs extra each month. Most people are fine with GPS. Go cellular only if you want to run or walk without your phone, or for a child using Family Setup.

## Which size?

The smaller size (40 or 42mm) suits smaller wrists and costs less; the larger (44 or 46mm) has a bigger screen and slightly longer battery. Try one on in a shop if you can. Remember an Apple Watch only works with an iPhone, not Android.

## When are Apple Watch prices lowest?

Black Friday and Amazon's Prime sales in July and October bring the deepest cuts, mostly at Amazon, with Currys, Argos and John Lewis usually matching. Apple itself doesn't discount. Many of Amazon's Black Friday prices are for Prime members only, so if you're not a member, start the [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) just before you buy. Our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains the timing.

Buying as a gift? Check the retailer's Christmas returns window, and buy from a big retailer rather than a marketplace seller.

For Apple's earbuds, see our [AirPods Pro deals guide](/guides/airpods-pro-deals-uk/). For more Black Friday prices, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) and our [Black Friday 2026 live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/).

### What is the cheapest Apple Watch in the UK?

The Apple Watch SE 3 40mm GPS at £219 (checked 16 November 2026). It's been £199 in past sales, so it could drop by Black Friday.

### Should I buy the Series 11 or Series 12?

The Series 11 at £319 is better value. The Series 12 is a small step up and £50 more. Choose it only if you want the newest model.

### Will Apple Watches be cheaper on Black Friday?

The SE 3 and Series 11 very likely, as both have been cheaper in past sales. The new Series 12 and Ultra 4 may see only small cuts. The Ultra 3 is already at its lowest price.

### Does Apple Watch work with Android?

No. You need an iPhone to set up and use an Apple Watch.
